scenes.text: It costs 11.3 cents to print a $100 bill.
scenes.say: [amazed] It costs eleven point three cents... to print a hundred-dollar bill.
scenes.head: $100 COSTS 11.3¢ TO PRINT

scenes.say: [curious] A one-dollar bill? Four point one.

scenes.text: So the hundred is the better deal.
scenes.say: [thinking] So the hundred is... the better deal.

scenes.text: I'll take a thousand. Of the hundreds.
scenes.say: [deadpan] I'll take a thousand. Of the hundreds.
